decisions.label: Leaf autumn jitter
decisions.note: How far each tree's leaves drift toward its own autumn colour (gold, orange, red, crimson or purple, by a seed of its own; some trees barely at all), kept as dark as the night makes them (Ed, 2026-10-19: "Why don't I see reds and oranges and purples from the jitter, only blue?"; it replaces the hue turn, which had no visible effect at night). 0: every tree of a variant the same, as before; 1: some trees fully autumn-coloured, well past sense. Live: no rebake.

decisions.label: Leaf hue jitter (degrees)
decisions.note: Each tree's leaves' hue turned up to this many degrees either way, by a seed of its own, on the lit colour (so these are degrees on screen; Ed's v3893 playtest: "no visible effect" when it was turned before the night's moonlight squeezed it). Up to 180 so any hue (Ed, 2026-10-19: "stretch the slider"); past about 30 trees read as other seasons. 0: none. Live: no rebake.

decisions.label: Leaf brightness jitter
decisions.note: Each tree's leaves brightened or darkened by up to this share, by a seed of its own. 0: none. The range goes well past sense (Ed: "bigger range"): past about 0.3 the darkest trees go near black. Live: no rebake.

decisions.label: Spooky colour grade
decisions.note: The spooky mood's night grade, how strongly (Ed, 2026-10-21: "Please put spooky colour grade as a slider in the leaf jitter section"): it drains and tints blue every tone darker than its pivot (light.spooky gradeDesat, gradePivot, gradeHue, gradeSat; render/post.ts COMPOSITE), which is why the autumn jitter's oranges end near grey at night and its reds go mauve. 0: no grade, the leaves' own colours; 0.9: as built. Each area's own tint still eases in as she crosses (render/mood.ts AreaMoods). Live: no rebake.
